settings.auto_per_hour_help: Summarize up to this many recently active discussions per hour without anyone asking, through the Flarum scheduler. 0 turns it off.
settings.instructions_help: Added to the built-in instructions, for example about tone or what to leave out.
settings.max_posts_help: Longer discussions are summarized from their first and last five posts plus the most liked ones in between.
settings.provider_text: Summaries use the provider and model set up in AI.

api.busy_message: A summary of this discussion is being written. Try again in a moment.
api.failed_message: The summary couldn't be written. Try again later.
api.too_short_message: {count, plural, one {A discussion needs at least # post to be summarized.} other {A discussion needs at least # posts to be summarized.}}
api.up_to_date_message: The summary already covers every reply.

summary.generated_text: AI-generated with {model} from {count, plural, one {# post} other {# posts}}, {ago}
summary.heading: AI summary
summary.new_replies_text: {count, plural, one {# new reply since} other {# new replies since}}
summary.remove_confirmation: Remove this summary? Anyone allowed to can write a new one.
